P5 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The map target is still chr21's map, because that is the only contact map this arc
ever scored against. Re-scoring the BANDS against the genome does not make the map
comparison genome-wide, and a full answer needs the sweep re-run against other
chromosomes' maps -- which loop 86 streamed and discarded, and which this disk at
2.4 GB free cannot hold.
The genome targets are means over 23 chromosomes weighted by size. A configuration
that matches the mean matches no particular chromosome, and chromosomes differ by
more than their spread suggests -- chr21 is 2.4 sd out on P(s) and it is a real
chromosome, not an error.
Re-scoring a stored grid cannot find a configuration the grid does not contain. If
the genome's optimum lies outside the 108 swept settings, nothing here would see it,
and P2 passing only means the grid brackets the genome, not that it is centred on it.
Loop 88's structural finding stands and is not weakened or strengthened by this
loop: the map and orientation objectives are opposed across the grid, and the whole
admissible range barely straddles a distance-only null.
